text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One evening, I spotted Bamboo Memory 
approaching Oguri Cap as she was taking a 
break by the track...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Mind if I join you for a break?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Mmh... Bamboo, is it? I don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Um... Senpai, do you like hot things? 
Like... how should I put it... something 
boiling hot and fiery-blazing...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: (Is she talking about a hot pot...?)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I knew it...! I thought so! Me too!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Senpai! Let's have a heated match 
someday, okay?!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
(A competition...? Is it really that 
hot-blooded? Well, I don't mind heat, 
so...)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Why wait for someday? We can start right 
now.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! Senpai really is in a league of 
her own!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'd rather save that for a proper 
stage, please! With that said...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"A proper setting...? A proper... Does 
Bamboo prefer high-end establishments?"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Regardless, hot pot with Bamboo, huh... 
Hehe... Sounds like fun.
